note: Draft go-bag list based on common preparedness guidance. Verify against NDRRMC/OCD material.

items.label: Ready-to-eat food and a can opener
IDs and important documents in a waterproof bag
Change of clothes and a blanket
Items for infants, elders or persons with disabilities

steps: Know your barangay's evacuation center and route.
Keep emergency numbers saved and written down.
Prepare your go-bag and keep it where everyone can find it.
Follow announcements from PAGASA and local officials.
Evacuate when told to, or earlier if water is rising.
Stay away from rivers, flooded roads and fallen power lines.
Return home only when officials say it is safe.
Report damage and needs to your barangay.
